principle_violations.reason: The PaymentProcessor interface enforces the implementation of auth_sms for all payment processors, even for those that do not require or support it, like PaypalPaymentProcessor and CreditCardPaymentProcessor.
principle_violations.suggestion: Split the PaymentProcessor interface into multiple interfaces so that classes only implement the methods they need. For example, create an AuthSmsCapable interface for processors that support SMS authentication.

overall_feedback: 1 principle violation found. Please see the details below.
